---
title: "Going further"
subtitle: "What we did not have time for"
---

These pages are for studying on your own after the course. Each one has a working app you can edit live, and the same app in the [`apps/`](https://github.com/ottaviae/stat-shiny/tree/main/apps) folder, ready for RStudio.

| Page | What you learn |
|---|---|
| [Layouts](layouts.qmd) | Organise the page: sidebar, rows and columns, tabs |
| [Updating inputs](update-inputs.qmd) | `observeEvent()` + `updateSelectInput()`, an alternative to `renderUI()`; `req()` |
| [Interactive plots](interactive-plots.qmd) | Click and brush on a plot; `reactiveValues()`; `validate()` |
| [Downloads](download.qmd) | Let the user download plots and results |
| [Resources](resources.qmd) | Slides, books and galleries |
